rules.name: Module serial no mapping
rules.expected: Every controller and electronic remote module has a unique SerialNumber datapoint binding; its four-byte integer variable or array element is transmitted exactly once on each applicable GC 420 path, with matching payload length and response setup.
rules.description: Every controller and electronic remote module has a unique SerialNumber datapoint binding; its four-byte integer variable or array element is transmitted exactly once on each applicable GC 420 path, with matching payload length and response setup.

serialCrossReferences.name: Hardware inventory
serialCrossReferences.requirement: Identify the active controller and electronic remote modules. Exclude passive terminals, bases and inactive configurations.

serialCrossReferences.name: SerialNumber I/O bindings
serialCrossReferences.requirement: Every inventoried module has one SerialNumber binding. Different modules must not own the same scalar or array element.

serialCrossReferences.name: PLC declarations
serialCrossReferences.requirement: Resolve each bound scalar or array element to an accepted four-byte integer type. Array indices and bulk-copy ranges must fit its declared bounds.

serialCrossReferences.name: Packet task ownership
serialCrossReferences.scope: Active configuration Cpu.sw and the matching mms_nw_r source
serialCrossReferences.requirement: Use LastUser.set to select the active configuration, or the single AS 2.7 configuration. Report unresolved selection instead of checking inactive targets.
